tests.name: expire_1s
tests.cmd: claim 1s sleep2 EXPIRED1 remain0 gate deny REQUIRE2

tests.name: num_partial
tests.cmd: NUM 2m →2 not fail; pure digit check

weaknesses.title: NUM partial-parses trailing junk (2m → 2, OK=1)
weaknesses.detail: SYS NUM on '2m' yields LAST_N=2 with OK=1 instead of soft fail. Agents treating NUM success as full parse silently mis-scale durations (2s not 120s). Must STR(NUM)==input pure-digit check.
weaknesses.repro: LET x='2m'; SYS NUM x → OK=1 LAST_N=2

weaknesses.title: PARSEMS bare digits are milliseconds not seconds
weaknesses.detail: PARSEMS '60' → 60ms; '60s' → 60000. Combined with DEADLINE floor(/1000) bare 60 becomes 0s TTL. Config authors write 60 meaning seconds and get instant expire.

weaknesses.title: EXPIRED clobbers LAST_N — breaks REMAINING chain
weaknesses.detail: SYS EXPIRED due leaves LAST_N=0|1. SYS REMAINING without saved due uses 0/1 as epoch → remain 0. Agents must LET due_save before probe pair.

weaknesses.title: EXPIRED/REMAINING empty or junk coerce to expired
weaknesses.detail: Empty string / non-numeric via var → OK=1 expired=1 (epoch0), not soft miss. No validation path for bad due plates.

weaknesses.title: Sub-second TTL floors to DEADLINE 0 → instant expire
weaknesses.detail: PARSEMS 500ms /1000 = 0; DEADLINE 0 marks due=now; EXPIRED boundary (>=) true immediately.

weaknesses.title: DEADLINE accepts negative seconds (past due)
weaknesses.detail: DEADLINE -10 stamps due in the past without soft fail. Silent claim already expired.

workarounds: Pure-digit check: STR(NUM x)==x before treating as seconds
Always use unit suffixes for PARSEMS (30s not 60)
Reject TTL < 1s after floor; never DEADLINE 0 for claims
Digit-check REQUIRE; CLEAR_ERR after soft PARSEMS
language_gaps: NUM strict full-string parse (reject trailing junk)
PARSEMS bare-number unit policy (ms vs s flag)
EXPIRED/REMAINING that preserve input epoch in side slot
Soft fail on non-numeric EXPIRED args
issues_faced: NUM 2m partial + PARSEMS bare-ms were core lessons; pure-digit workaround
EXPIRED LAST_N clobber forces due_save pattern
selftest 280/280; no language fix this iter
